title: Be brave enough to kill the inner tyrant
summary: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life. Aim courage at ego before conflict at another person.
takeaway: Aim courage at ego before conflict at another person.
lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens, ask first what ego wants to win; then choose the praise or restraint that subdues it.
